$description: Raw / base spacing tier. Literal dimensions. The single base input the content-margin ladders derive from, and the max page-content width. Derived steps live in semantic/layout.json.

content-margin-base.$description: The base input both content-margin ladders (inline and block) derive from.

max-content-width.$description: Max width page content grows to. Equals Tailwind's --container-7xl and its xl breakpoint.

max-content-width-narrow.$description: Narrower max width for reading-oriented pages (followup XKY2), for use alongside a wider global --mf-max-content-width shell. Applied the same way as max-content-width: a page opts in via a scoped override of --mf-max-content-width-narrow, not a global change.
